q: EPFO Member Passbook Balance Check - Detailed Guide 2 in 2026?
q_en: How to manage EPFO Member Passbook Balance Check via EPFO / Pension portal in 2026?
answer:
Sarkari Seva Overview & Guidance 2026

EPFO Member Passbook Balance Check ke liye official portal unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in par login kare. UAN Number/PPO Number aur Password se authenticate kare. Service section me jaakar aavashyak online claim ya KYC update submit kare. Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) ke madhyam se rashi seedhe khate me bheji jaati hai. Application status 'Track Claim' option se dekhe. Source: unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in

Aavedan Prakriya - Step by Step Process

  • Official portal https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in par visit kare.
  • Apna Mobile Number aur OTP dalkar authentication complete kare.
  • Form me zaroori jankari jaise Name, Address, Aadhaar Details, Bank Passbook bhare.
  • Scanned copies of required documents upload kare aur eKYC verify kare.
  • NetBanking / UPI / SBI ePay se prescribe fees pay kare aur acknowledgement slip save kare.

Zaroori Documents List (Required Proofs)

  • Aadhaar Card (Mobile Number Linked)
  • Voter ID Card / Domicile Certificate / Address Proof
  • Income Certificate & Bank Passbook Copy
  • Recent Passport Size Photograph

Helpline & Official Source

Kuch bhi samasya hone par official portal https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in par Grievance section check kare ya Toll-Free Number 1800-11-0001 par call kare. Source: https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in
